I had already paid for all three cleaning sessions, but on my third visit I was told that the cleaning was no longer required. This was confusing, unprofessional, and felt unfair.

Unfortunately, my experience felt more business-focused than patient-focused, especially when the doctor said these are Bombay Market, Tardeo area charges, which made me feel as though the discussion was more about business. Anyway, I will consider that I donated the cost of my third cleaning session in the holy month of Vaishakh. 😂

featured_reviews.name: Lavesh Nagria
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had an excellent experience with Dr. Charmi Mehta during my root canal and capping dental treatment. Even though I had very limited time, she clearly explained the diagnostic results and the treatment plan, which really put me at ease. The staff is calm, composed, and very supportive.

Talking to Dr. Charmi is always a pleasure, she’s a true champ at her work, never rushes, and always aims for perfection. I’ve experienced this level of care twice now. She truly sets the benchmark for professional and patient-centric dental care. In short she is exceptionally fantabulous. I would happily recommend her to all my family and friends.
Thank you Dr Charmi Mehta….
